name: Exp_Go
summary: This EA trades based on the custom 'Go' indicator's trend signals, opening buy positions when the trend shifts from bearish to bullish and sell positions when it shifts from bullish to bearish. It includes configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and separate controls for opening and closing positions on each side. The strategy is a classic trend-following system that enters on trend reversal signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Go'指标的趋势信号进行交易，当趋势从空头转为多头时开多仓，从多头转为空头时开空仓。它包含可配置的资金管理模式、止损/止盈以及买卖双方的开仓和平仓独立控制。该策略是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，在趋势反转信号时入场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA是一个基于自定义Go指标的趋势跟踪系统，通过检测指标缓冲区中趋势值的切换来捕捉趋势反转。入场条件：当Go指标的缓冲区1在SignalBar处从值2切换到值1时，视为多头信号，开多仓；当从值1切换到值2时，视为空头信号，开空仓。出场条件：支持止损和止盈出场，同时在趋势反转时也会主动平掉反向仓位（如多头信号出现时平空仓）。仓位管理：提供五种资金管理模式，包括基于可用保证金、余额、亏损后可用保证金、亏损后余额以及固定手数模式。资金管理：通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择计算方式，StopLoss和TakeProfit分别设为1000和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略还包含新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线上重复交易，并在指标数据不足时跳过交易。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA is a trend-following system based on the custom Go indicator, capturing trend reversals by detecting shifts in the indicator's buffer values. Entry conditions: A buy signal is generated when the Go indicator buffer 1 transitions from value 2 to value 1 at the SignalBar; a sell signal triggers when it transitions from value 1 to value 2. Exit conditions: The EA uses stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) for exits, and also actively closes opposite positions upon trend reversal signals (e.g., closing sells when a buy signal appears). Position sizing: Five money management modes are available including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot sizing. Money management: The MM parameter controls the risk fraction, MMMode selects the calculation method, and the stop loss to take profit ratio is 1:2, providing a favorable risk-reward profile. The strategy also implements a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades on the same bar and skips trading when insufficient indicator data is available.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Margin usage ratio for lot size calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net loss/fixed lots)

pros: 风险回报比为1:2，具有正期望值的交易逻辑
提供五种资金管理模式，灵活性高
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，便于精细化策略调整
新K线检测机制避免重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈设置完整，风险控制有基本保障
pros_en: Risk-reward ratio of 1:2 provides a positive expectancy trading logic
Five money management modes offer high flexibility in position sizing
Independent control of buy/sell opening and closing allows fine-grained strategy tuning
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades and reduces overtrading risk
Complete stop loss and take profit settings provide basic risk control safeguards
cons: 依赖自定义Go指标，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号有效性
止损设为1000点过大，在多数品种上可能承受较大浮亏
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
指标周期174为非标准参数，可能存在过度拟合风险
未包含追踪止损功能，无法在趋势中锁定浮动利润
cons_en: Depends on a custom Go indicator whose logic is opaque and hard to verify for signal validity
Stop loss of 1000 points is excessively large and may result in significant drawdowns on most instruments
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially entering under unfavorable conditions
Non-standard indicator period of 174 raises overfitting concerns
No trailing stop feature to lock in floating profits during trending moves
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在不利条件下开仓
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势运行中逐步锁定利润
对Go指标周期参数进行步进优化测试，验证174是否为过拟合参数
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entering under unfavorable conditions
Implement a trailing stop feature to progressively lock in profits during trending moves
Conduct step-forward optimization testing on the Go indicator period to verify whether 174 is an overfitted parameter

risk_points: 止损1000点过大，单笔交易可能造成较大亏损
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
自定义指标逻辑不透明，信号可靠性难以独立验证
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points is very large and can cause significant loss per trade
No spread filter means entries during high-spread conditions could result in unfavorable fills
Custom indicator logic is opaque, making signal reliability hard to independently verify
